title: Rafael and the Witness
author: Bram Joubert
blurb: Lior Almeida, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
